facts.big: I’d like · Can I · Would you like
facts.label: Pedir um quarto
facts.sub: Use I’d like + coisa para pedir e Can I + verbo base para perguntar se pode. Quem atende pergunta Would you like…?

facts.label: Gostaria
facts.sub: Use I’d like + coisa para pedir com educação: I’d like a room for two nights. É mais gentil do que I want. Termine com please para soar mais amável.

facts.label: Posso
facts.sub: Use Can I + verbo base para perguntar se é possível: Can I have a room with a view? Can I pay by card? A resposta curta é Yes, you can ou I’m sorry, you can’t.

pages.title: A small hotel · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday evening at a small hotel in Leeds. Rain falls on the street outside. Rui comes in with a wet coat. He is tired after a long day. Pablo works at the front desk. He gives him a warm smile.
“Good evening, sir. How can I help you?” says Pablo. “I’d like a room for two nights, please.” says Rui. “Sure. Would you like a double room or a single room?” says Pablo.
